query: hierarchical model reviews for aspect based sentiment analysis
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    (p.title ILIKE '%hierarchical%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%hierarchical%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%aspect%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%aspect%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%sentiment%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%sentiment%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%hierarchical model%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%hierarchical model%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%aspect-based sentiment%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%aspect-based sentiment%' OR
         p.title ILIKE '%aspect based sentiment%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%aspect based sentiment%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%hierarchical%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%hierarchical%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%review%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%review%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%sentiment%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%sentiment%')
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%hierarchical model%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%hierarchical model%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%aspect-based sentiment%' OR p.title ILIKE '%aspect based sentiment%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%aspect-based sentiment%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%aspect based sentiment%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%aspect%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%aspect%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%review%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%review%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%sentiment%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%sentiment%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC,
  p.year DESC
LIMIT 100
